unit: Fire cell-days: unique H3 resolution-8 cell (~0.74 km²) × day with ≥1 detection, per sensor.

harmonization.method: median of monthly MODIS/VIIRS ratios per calendar month over full overlap months (masked data); province-specific when ≥6 overlap years with ≥30 cell-days in both sensors and within 0.5–2× the national value, else national
harmonization.formula: H = mean(MODIS, α_SNPP[m]·SNPP, α_NOAA20[m]·NOAA20) over sensors covering ≥50% of the month; MODIS only before 2012.

anomaly.formula: Z = (H − median) / IQR of the same calendar month (std if IQR is 0); partial months are projected to a full month first.

staticMask.rule: FIRMS type 1 (volcano), 2 (static land source), 3 (offshore), plus H3 res-8 cells with detections on >60 distinct days across ≥8 calendar months in one year.

attribution: NASA FIRMS (MODIS C6.1, VIIRS 375 m) — https://firms.modaps.eosdis.nasa.gov
